title: Game state
description: The complete match document: lobby, turn state, board, players, markets, deck and log. Broadcast in full on every update, after per-recipient hand redaction.

seats.description: Player id to seat. Present from match creation, before anyone joins.

host-id.description: Player id of the seat that may start the game. Null until the first player sits down.

started.description: Set by the host-start move. Before it, the match is in the lobby phase.

seat-count.description: Seated players at the moment the game started. Fixes the deck config and the active merchant set; 0 while still in the lobby.

era.description: Current era. The transition purges level-1 tiles, clears every link, resets merchant barrels, reshuffles discards and redeals to 8.

round.description: Rounds completed plus one; starts at 1. Incremented at end of round, after income is collected and turn order is rebuilt. Round 1 of the canal era is the one-action round.

actions-this-turn.description: Actions taken in the current turn. One in the first round of the canal era, two thereafter.

awaiting-commit.description: Action budget spent. While set, the ONLY legal move is confirmTurn; an action never ends a turn on its own.

order.description: Turn order for the current round. Rebuilt at end of round ascending by each player's spend.

players.description: Player id to player state. Rebuilt per recipient by playerView, which redacts every other seat's hand.

tiles.description: Every industry tile on the board, all owners.

links.description: Every canal or rail token on the board. Emptied entirely at the era transition.

coal-market.description: Cubes on the coal market. 14 spaces priced 1..7, two per price; setup 13; an empty market sells at 8 without limit.

iron-market.description: Cubes on the iron market. 10 spaces priced 1..5, two per price; setup 8; an empty market sells at 6 without limit.

merchants.description: Merchant tiles in the active commerce slots: 5 at 2 seats, 7 at 3, 9 at 4.

deck.description: Draw pile, in order. Not redacted: order is visible to any client that reads it.

wild-location.description: Wild Location cards left in the shared pool. Starts at 4 at every seat count; Scout takes one, a discard returns one.

wild-industry.description: Wild Industry cards left in the shared pool. Starts at 4 at every seat count.

next-tile-id.description: Counter for built-tile ids. Also read (without being incremented) when Scout mints wild card ids.

next-link-id.description: Counter for built-link ids. Independent of next-tile-id.

ended.description: Set when the rail era finishes and final scoring has run.

winner.description: winners[0], for single-winner consumers. Reading it alone silently discards a shared victory.

winners.description: Authoritative winner list. Ranked by victory points, then income LEVEL, then money; every player tying the leader on all three shares the win.

log.description: Human-readable event log, append-only for the match. The MCP state view publishes only the last 15 entries.
